title: Would You Take the Penny or $1 Million?

titles.option_b_contrarian: The Penny Beats the Million (Here's Why)
titles.option_c_search_hybrid: Exponential Growth: The Penny Doubling Trap

detected_concept: exponential growth, the penny doubling problem
description:
One million dollars today, or a single penny that doubles every day for thirty days. Which would you take?

Day ten is just $5.12. Day twenty is over $5,000. By day thirty that one cent has grown past $5.3 million, more than five times the cash on offer. This short shows why. Exponential growth multiplies the whole pile every day instead of adding a fixed amount, and our brains expect straight lines, not curves. The Bauhaus-style animation walks through the doubling day by day, from one cent to the final day, so you can see exactly where intuition breaks.

Would you trust your gut or the math?
